columns.name: ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier to identify the email entry record

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CLIENT_CONFIGURATION
columns.description: Compilation of client related details as a json string

columns.name: FOLDERS
columns.description: Folders from which email has to be read in case of email communication.

columns.name: SOURCE
columns.description: identifier for the source of the account creation

columns.name: CALLBACK_CLASS
columns.description: identifier for any associated callback class with the account

columns.name: ACCOUNT_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: identifier from the consumer who created the account

columns.name: IS_PROCESS_SPECIFIC
columns.description: flag to identify if created account is specific to a process

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Enterprise id against which this email entry record has been created

columns.name: PROVIDER
columns.description: Identifier to recognize the email client type like gmail/outlook

columns.name: ADDRESS

columns.name: IS_ACTIVE

columns.name: SCHEDULED_JOB_ID
